description: This file defines the VPCLatticeClient class for interacting with the Amazon VPC Lattice service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various API operations that the client can perform. The class extends AwsClient and is part of the Aws\VPCLattice namespace.

classes.name: VPCLatticeClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon VPC Lattice service via the AWS SDK for PHP. Extends the AwsClient class to provide methods for API operations such as creating, deleting, and listing resources related to VPC lattice.

methods.name: batchUpdateRule
methods.description: Executes a batch update of rules in the VPC Lattice service.

methods.name: createAccessLogSubscription
methods.description: Creates a new access log subscription.

methods.name: createServiceNetworkResourceAssociation
methods.description: Creates an association between a service network and a resource.

methods.name: createServiceNetworkServiceAssociation
methods.description: Associates a service network with a service.

methods.name: createServiceNetworkVpcAssociation
methods.description: Associates a service network with a VPC.

methods.name: deleteServiceNetworkResourceAssociation
methods.description: Deletes a service network resource association.

methods.name: deleteServiceNetworkServiceAssociation
methods.description: Deletes a service network service association.

methods.name: deleteServiceNetworkVpcAssociation
methods.description: Deletes an association between a service network and a VPC.

methods.name: getAccessLogSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves details about an access log subscription.

methods.name: getServiceNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves information about a service network.

methods.name: getServiceNetworkResourceAssociation
methods.description: Gets a service network resource association.

methods.name: getServiceNetworkServiceAssociation
methods.description: Gets a service network service association.

methods.name: getServiceNetworkVpcAssociation
methods.description: Gets a service network VPC association.

methods.name: listServiceNetworkResourceAssociations
methods.description: Lists resource associations for a service network.

methods.name: listServiceNetworkVpcAssociations
methods.description: Lists VPC associations for a service network.

methods.name: putAuthPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates an authentication policy.

methods.name: putResourcePolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates a resource policy.

methods.name: updateServiceNetworkVpcAssociation
methods.description: Updates a VPC association for a service network.
